Build passes. All 37 tests fail against the stubs as required.

37 tests in 4 files.

Open in the spec:

These public tests prohibit extra returned fields through exact object comparisons; the spec leaves additional fields unspecified:

- “funding adds to held and accumulates across entries” — balance fields.
- “funding accepts the minimum and maximum valid amounts” — balance fields.
- “releasing deducts gross amounts and accumulates net pay per contributor” — balance fields.
- “a one-unit release permits zero and full fee rates” — balance fields.
- “the maximum safe amount has an exact fee at 9999 basis points” — balance fields.
- “refunds reduce held and accumulate the total returned to the funder” — balance fields.
- “a one-unit refund takes no fee even at the full fee rate” — balance fields.
- “entries retain their fields and order while balances follow the record” — entry and balance fields.
- “an empty record starts at sequence one and rejections and retries add no entries” — entry and balance fields.
